help_intro: Add Translator Bot to a Group chat and enable translation with the following commands:
help_set_american: /set american - Translate All languages to American English
help_set_mandarin: /set mandarin - Translate All languages to Traditional Chinese (Taiwan)
help_set_japanese: /set japanese - Translate All languages to Japanese
help_set_pair: /set pair <lang1> <lang2> - sets specific language pair (e.g., /set pair zh-tw en)
help_pair_options:
"zh-TW"  # Traditional Chinese, also accepts "tw",
   "zh-CN"  # Simplified Chinese, also accepts "cn",
   "ja"  # Japanese, also accepts "jpn",
   "th"  # Thai,
   "id"  # Indonesian, also accepts "ind",
   "fil"  # Filipino, also accepts "filipino", "tagalog", "tl"
   "vi"  # Vietnamese, also accepts "vie", "vietnamese",
   "en", "fr", "de", "it", "es", "ko"  # English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Korean
help_lang: /lang <code> - set UI language (any supported language code, e.g. ko, es, zh-tw, zh-cn, ja)
help_subscribe_telegram: /subscribe - subscribe to spoken voice translation with Telegram Stars
help_activate_group: /activate group - share your subscription with this group
help_set_voice: /set voice on|off - enable or disable spoken translation replies
help_set_voice_gender: /set voice male|female - choose the spoken voice (default female)
help_terms: /terms - terms of sale for the Stars subscription
help_voice_paid_only: Voice-to-text is only available to paid customers!
help_voice_telegram: Voice notes are translated to text for free. Spoken voice replies require a Telegram Stars subscription (/subscribe, then /set voice on).

help_translate_all_link: For Translate All modes, see: https://docs.cloud.google.com/text-to-speech/docs/list-voices-and-types for supported languages.

terms_of_sale:
Terms of sale

Spoken voice translation is a digital subscription sold in Telegram Stars.

- Billing: 30-day recurring Stars subscription. The price is shown on the invoice.
- What you get: spoken translations of voice notes when /set voice on is enabled.
- Cancellation: cancel the Stars subscription in Telegram. Access continues until the current period ends.
- Refunds: contact /paysupport. Telegram does not handle bot purchase disputes.
- Translations are provided as-is and may be unavailable during outages.
